name.description:
name of the team is used as the identifier to get MsTeamsteam config
eg: MsTeamsTeam.forConfigKey("jarvis-test3") where jarvis-test3 is the team name

title:
Config for teams in MsTeams
The incoming webhook connector needs to be created for the team-channel,
then create a MsteamsTeam config with team-name as identifier eg. MsTeamsTeam.make({name: "team-name"}) and
set config for channels.
